body:
Greg's word, relayed verbatim by Engram::Advisor (TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #1381, 2026-10-20 21:03:55Z), in answer to my #1380 about the w-c931 two-host rollout:

"Greg authorizes the required A↔Mac pair re-activation after the w-c931 rollout, provided both hosts run the landed compatible build and the fresh 9/9 pair verification passes. No separate activation prompt is needed at that point. He also directs: no legacy compatibility, silent downgrade, or shim path; mixed versions must fail explicitly as upgradeRequired. Keep ordinary exact-basis build/restart notices."

Application:
- At the w-c931 rollout, the pair re-activation needs no new prompt, IF both hosts run the landed compatible build AND a fresh 9/9 verification passes.
- Restart notices still go via Advisor with build hashes.
- Implementation must not add v1 compatibility or shims.
